finite_lessons: Controlled missing-read evidence can copy an already-read snapshot or mask one local consumer result after unchanged real SDK reads, rather than replace an SDK getter namespace.
Qualification adapter must preserve non-target nil/false/error and exact variadic arity; copied records must not mutate original source snapshots.
Private package transform needs strict unique source sites, full inverse equality, all unrelated file bytes and actualZIP validation; software success never grants Native acceptance.
